adapter_contract.clip_resolution: one sealed Qwen or Gemma CLIP lease retained for the complete call
adapter_contract.qwen_media: IMAGE only; VIDEO and AUDIO reject before RNG open
adapter_contract.gemma3_media: zero or one IMAGE; VIDEO and AUDIO reject before RNG open
adapter_contract.gemma4_media: VIDEO takes precedence over IMAGE; AUDIO is independent for E2B/E4B and rejected for 31B
adapter_contract.rng: one prompt-attempt-node-addressed Philox replay transaction opens after handle validation and media preparation
adapter_contract.publication: the adapter returns one staged scalar result and never publishes handles, cache state, KV, prepared media, or partial text

failure_matrix: wrong CLIP role, type, store, generation, or digest
decoder-only, diffusion, SD1, or CLIP-vision resource presented as multimodal
unsupported family/media capability or marker count
cancellation or workspace exhaustion before and after every bounded preparation/generation phase
